title: Completed PMO Maturity Assessment Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed PMO Maturity Assessment artifact data payloads (PMO-00.05).

assessment_purpose_and_scope.description: What this PMO maturity assessment covers, the organizational boundaries evaluated, and the strategic improvement rationale behind the exercise.

assessment_lead_and_date.description: The designated assessor or governance review team accountable for the evaluation, and the baseline assessment completion date.

target_maturity_level.description: The desired future maturity tier (Levels 1 to 5) targeted by the PMO across defined strategic planning horizons.

governance_and_strategy_alignment.description: Scored capability rating and evidentiary findings regarding portfolio decision-making, strategic prioritization, and executive reporting alignment.

delivery_support_and_methodology.description: Scored capability rating and evidentiary findings regarding standard delivery framework adoption, lifecycle gates, and PM coaching support.

people_and_competency_development.description: Scored capability rating and evidentiary findings regarding project management professional pathways, mentoring programs, and training curricula.

performance_and_reporting.description: Scored capability rating and evidentiary findings regarding milestone tracking, earned value visibility, variance logging, and KPI reporting.

tools_and_technology_ecosystem.description: Scored capability rating and evidentiary findings regarding PMIS tooling integration, workflow automation, and collaborative repository usage.

capability_gap_description.description: The specific operational or structural gap separating current maturity performance from target capability requirements.

improvement_initiative.description: The prioritized transformative action, process overhaul, or technology deployment planned to close the identified capability gap.

initiative_owner_and_timeline.description: The accountable individual responsible for delivery and the committed milestone completion date for the improvement initiative.
